messages.subject: Employment law update seminar — 27 March (CPD)
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi both,

We've reserved places at the Employment Lawyers Association half-day update on 27 March (whistleblowing and Vento band developments — very relevant!). It counts towards your CPD. Let me know if you'd like me to confirm your attendance and lunch.

Donna
